p5_2_20201101_reconciliation.query:
SELECT
                'source' AS side,
                COUNT(*) AS event_count,
                COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase') AS purchase_count,
                COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase' AND
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.transaction_id') IS NOT NULL)
                    AS purchase_with_transaction_id,
                COUNT(DISTINCT IF(event_name = 'purchase',
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.transaction_id'), NULL))
                    AS distinct_transaction_ids,
                COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase' AND
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.purchase_revenue') IS NOT NULL)
                    AS purchase_revenue_count,
                SUM(IF(event_name = 'purchase', SAFE_CAST(
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.purchase_revenue') AS BIGNUMERIC
                ), NULL)) AS purchase_revenue_total,
                COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase' AND
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.purchase_revenue_in_usd') IS NOT NULL)
                    AS purchase_revenue_usd_count,
                SUM(IF(event_name = 'purchase', SAFE_CAST(
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.purchase_revenue_in_usd') AS BIGNUMERIC
                ), NULL)) AS purchase_revenue_usd_total
            FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20201101`
            WHERE TRUE
        
UNION ALL

            SELECT
                'raw' AS side,
                COUNT(*) AS event_count,
                COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase') AS purchase_count,
                COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase' AND
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.transaction_id') IS NOT NULL)
                    AS purchase_with_transaction_id,
                COUNT(DISTINCT IF(event_name = 'purchase',
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.transaction_id'), NULL))
                    AS distinct_transaction_ids,
                COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase' AND
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.purchase_revenue') IS NOT NULL)
                    AS purchase_revenue_count,
                SUM(IF(event_name = 'purchase', SAFE_CAST(
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.purchase_revenue') AS BIGNUMERIC
                ), NULL)) AS purchase_revenue_total,
                COUNTIF(event_name = 'purchase' AND
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.purchase_revenue_in_usd') IS NOT NULL)
                    AS purchase_revenue_usd_count,
                SUM(IF(event_name = 'purchase', SAFE_CAST(
                    JSON_VALUE(TO_JSON_STRING(ecommerce), '$.purchase_revenue_in_usd') AS BIGNUMERIC
                ), NULL)) AS purchase_revenue_usd_total
            FROM `ga4-checkout-funnel.ga4_raw.ga4_events`
            WHERE event_date = @event_date

partition_comparison_filtered.query:
SELECT
            COUNT(*) AS scan_scope_rows,
            COUNTIF(event_date BETWEEN @first_day AND @last_day) AS window_events,
            COUNT(DISTINCT IF(event_date BETWEEN @first_day AND @last_day, event_date, NULL)) AS observed_window_days,
            COUNTIF((event_date BETWEEN @first_day AND @last_day) AND event_name = 'purchase') AS window_purchase_events,
            SUM(IF((event_date BETWEEN @first_day AND @last_day) AND event_name = 'purchase',
                COALESCE(CAST(ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd AS BIGNUMERIC), 0), 0))
                AS window_purchase_revenue_usd
        FROM `ga4-checkout-funnel.ga4_raw.ga4_events`
        WHERE event_date BETWEEN @first_day AND @last_day
